create_v0_chat_config: create a V0ChatConfig instance to configure OpenAI-compatible v0 API integration
get_v0_api_base_url: get the v0 API base URL from environment variable or default to https://api.v0.dev/v1
retrieve_v0_api_key: retrieve the v0 API key from environment variable V0_API_KEY or passed argument
check_supported_openai_params: check which OpenAI parameters are supported by the v0 chat completions endpoint
configure_v0_llm_provider: configure the v0 custom LLM provider with api_base and api_key for chat completions
